instructions: Write as if the Polish product were created in Poland from the beginning.
Preserve mechanics, facts, character roles, safety and claim boundaries.
Do not reconstruct English metaphors, sentence order or motivational cadence.
Prefer concrete contemporary family Polish, situational humor and spoken rhythm.
Avoid corporate coaching, therapy-speak, imported mindfulness phrasing and forced youth slang.

units.function: Replace golden-inner-light visualization with a concrete breathing pause while retaining circle/breath structure.
mechanics: Sit in a circle.
Take several calm, unforced breaths.
Use the breath/body as the focus for a short pause.
immutable_facts: Luli's source note says to let inner light grow gently.
character_roles: Luli can undercut decorative imagery with a practical line.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not claim breathing feeds an inner light or guarantees calm.
units.tone_job: Simple Christmas-season pause, not spiritual visualization.
units.humor_room: Let the actual Christmas lights do the shining.

units.function: Use movement to show how strongly each person connects with a reflective sentence, with rotating starter and two-person variant.
mechanics: Form a circle around the oldest person, who starts.
Starter chooses one reflective sentence from the supplied list or creates one and finishes it honestly.
Other family members respond with movement: step closer to center = strong connection; one step back = gentle connection.
Change starter anti-clockwise.
Two-person version: stand face to face; one shares; the other steps forward for strong connection or back for gentle connection; then switch roles.
immutable_facts: Source prompt list includes identity, truth today, invisible important thing, growth, a word that feels like home, and a strengthening word.
Oldest person starts.
Anti-clockwise starter rotation.
Mimi says no choreography/judging panel.
safety_claim_boundaries: No one should be judged or interrogated about their movement.
Keep floor clear for small steps.

units.function: Each person shares one personal lesson/discovery from the month about self or family.
mechanics: Each person completes the source idea: This month, I learned...
Answer can be a personal discovery or something new noticed about self/family.
immutable_facts: One lesson per person is sufficient.
Mimi jokes life does not take holidays.
safety_claim_boundaries: No pressure for a profound lesson.
units.humor_room: Life as teacher can be lightly joked about, not sermonized.

units.function: Use the snow-globe image as a playful one-minute Christmas visualization without claiming it calms the mind.
mechanics: Imagine being inside a calm snow globe.
Watch imagined snow fall for one minute.
immutable_facts: Duration is one minute.
Alio warns not to shake the imaginary snow globe.
character_roles: Alio turns the image into physical comedy.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not claim thoughts must stop or the exercise guarantees calm.
units.tone_job: Seasonal visual pause that still feels playful.
units.humor_room: Do not shake it again—especially Alio.
units.cultural_friction: Avoid mindfulness vocabulary about thoughts settling.

units.function: Run a three-round spot-switching game that reveals light facts/preferences/traits.
mechanics: Stand together in a circle.
First caller is the person whose birthday is closest to the middle of the year.
Round 1 Color Challenge: caller names a color; everyone wearing it quickly and safely switches spots; play a few color rounds.
Round 2 Likes & Dislikes: move clockwise to the next caller, who names a preference category; everyone it applies to switches spots.
Round 3 Habits & Traits: next caller names a light trait/habit category; everyone it applies to switches spots.
Continue while enjoyable and invent own categories.
immutable_facts: Birthday closest to mid-year selects first caller.
Round order is Colors -> Likes/Dislikes -> Habits/Traits.
Clockwise caller progression.
Dilo says quick swaps only.
safety_claim_boundaries: Switch spots safely; no pushing/running into furniture.
units.tone_job: Energetic get-to-know-you game with precise round structure.
units.humor_room: Slow motion belongs in dramatic movies.

units.function: Invite one simple sincere recent apology without making apology performance compulsory.
mechanics: Sit together in a circle.
Starter turns to person on their right and says: I am sorry for... followed by a real recent example they want to apologize for.
immutable_facts: Apology should be simple and recent.
Alio says apologies do not need fireworks.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not force anyone to invent an apology or disclose conflict publicly.
Do not treat apology as automatic repair; recipient does not owe forgiveness on demand.

units.function: Close the daily RESET sequence with one minute of family silence and an outward good-wish focus, without shared-light halo imagery.
mechanics: Sit together in silence.
Hold hands only if everyone wants.
Breathe normally for one minute.
Use the final pause to extend attention beyond the immediate room/home.
immutable_facts: Duration is one minute.
Mimi asks the family to stay a moment longer.
Source expands shared light beyond home/world.
units.humor_room: One more minute; the rest can wait.
units.cultural_friction: Replace glowing-halo/world-light imagery with a concrete good wish.

units.function: Sing one chosen Christmas/winter song together, with festive-color starter.
mechanics: Stand or sit close together.
Choose one favorite Christmas carol or winter song.
Person wearing the most festive color starts the first line.
Everyone joins and sings the rest together.
immutable_facts: One song is enough.
Dilo says perfection optional, joy required.
safety_claim_boundaries: No lyric text needs to be printed; families choose their own song.
units.cultural_friction: Avoid grand claims about purest form of celebration.

units.function: Close Advent with two rounds: one concrete gratitude from the 24 days and one family wish for Christmas/New Year.
mechanics: Round 1: each person says one thing they are grateful for that happened during this Advent, connected to shared moments/feelings/time together.
Round 2: each person says one heartfelt wish for the family for Christmas and the New Year.
immutable_facts: Both gratitude and wish rounds are required.
Happy Makers note says shy hopes count.
character_roles: Collective Happy Makers voice should be warm, not syrupy.
safety_claim_boundaries: No one must produce a profound answer.
units.tone_job: Warm close that feels earned after 24 days.
units.humor_room: One true thank-you and one wish are enough.
